sanity_expectations: F_max is positive over the entire sampled region
F_max increases monotonically with N (dominated by mu*N plus saturating adhesion)
adhesion term A_adh*(1-exp(-N/N_ref)) saturates toward A_adh as N >> N_ref
F_max increases with dwell time t_dwell (logarithmic static aging)
F_max increases with temperature T through the thermally activated aging factor
the negative junction-softening term slightly reduces the slope at large N but never dominates
excitation_report: sigma=0.3, k=5. Per-term RMS multiples of sigma over the sampled region: N*mu = 102.3x (dominant); A_adh adhesion-saturation term = 56.2x; alpha_rate aging-log term = 38.9x; k_junc junction-softening term = 5.47x (raised k_junc 0.05->0.09 to clear 5σ); NEW coupling term tau_shear*A_adh/N_ref*(1-exp(-N/N_ref))*tanh(...) = 5.08x RMS, peak effect 2.00 (6.67x sigma), strongest at N~94.7, mu~0.29, t_dwell~9717, T~351. All terms visible; no weak terms.
role_corrections: F_max: output->output (confirmed: LHS, target absent from RHS, explicitly solvable)
N: V->V (confirmed sampling axis; differentiates all terms)
mu: V->V (confirmed sampling axis; surface preparation is varied experimentally)
t_dwell: V->V (confirmed sampling axis; drives aging log term)
T: V->V (confirmed sampling axis; sets thermal-activation factor)
k_junc: P->P (confirmed; value tuned 0.05->0.09 for excitation, physically reasonable)
tau_shear: P->P (confirmed; fixed = 5, top of suggested 0.1-5 range for max visibility of new term)
rationale: Explicit static force law (no derivatives/integrals; F_max solvable directly). Four experimental knobs are sampled as independent axes: normal load N (1-100 N), friction coefficient mu (0.2-0.8, the 'surface preparation' knob), dwell time t_dwell (1-1e4 s, log-sampled to cover the aging logarithm), and temperature T (250-400 K). All other symbols are fixed physical parameters, including the Boltzmann constant. Parameters chosen so Q_act/(k_B*T) ~ O(1) and t_dwell*exp(-Q/kT)/t_ref spans decades, exciting the aging and coupling channels. auto_balance drove tau_shear to 6.4 to reach 5σ, but that exceeds the suggested 0.1-5 range; keeping tau_shear=5 still clears 5σ (RMS 5.08x, peak 6.67x), so it was capped at 5. k_junc raised 0.05->0.09 so the junction-softening term also clears 5σ. Noise sigma=0.3 N is small vs the dominant terms (tens of N) yet leaves the ~2 N new coupling term clearly visible.

scenario_text: A block rests on a horizontal surface, and a slowly increasing horizontal pull is applied until the block begins to slide. Experimenters vary the normal load pressing the block down and the surface preparation. They record the maximum tangential force that the contact can sustain just before motion begins. The measured threshold force scales with the pressing load and the contact condition.
